title: 超音波乳化白內障手術

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出超音波乳化白內障手術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Phacoemulsification cataract surgery.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：角膜切口、連續環形撕囊、水分離、乳化碎核與人工水晶體植入。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Corneal incision, capsulorhexis, hydrodissection, nucleus emulsification and IOL implantation.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
核已分離。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Nucleus freed.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
切口自閉。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Self-sealing incision.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
核完全清除。
切口自閉。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Nucleus fully removed.
Self-sealing incision.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依超音波乳化白內障手術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Phacoemulsification cataract surgery.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
核已分離。
IOL 在囊袋內、切口密閉。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Nucleus freed.
IOL in the bag, wounds sealed.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 超音波乳化白內障手術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Phacoemulsification cataract surgery.

steps.title: 麻醉與角膜切口
steps.objective: 完成表面／球周麻醉與自閉式角膜切口。
steps.objectiveEn: Topical/peribulbar anaesthesia and self-sealing corneal incisions.
steps.instruction: 表面麻醉加前房內 lidocaine；側切口 1 mm，主切口 2.2–2.75 mm 三平面透明角膜切口。
steps.instructionEn: Topical anaesthesia plus intracameral lidocaine; 1 mm side port, 2.2–2.75 mm triplanar clear-corneal main incision.
steps.observation: 注入黏彈劑維持前房。
steps.observationEn: Fill the chamber with viscoelastic.
steps.failure: 切口過短或過長影響密閉性與散光。
steps.failureEn: Incisions too short or long affect sealing and astigmatism.
steps.check: 切口自閉。
steps.checkEn: Self-sealing incision.

knowledge.title: 散光管理
knowledge.text: 切口位置可置於陡軸以矯正小度散光。
knowledge.textEn: Placing the incision on the steep axis corrects small astigmatism.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與角膜切口」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and corneal incisions'?
options: 切口自閉。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
核已分離。
IOL 在囊袋內、切口密閉。
optionsEn: Self-sealing incision.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Nucleus freed.
IOL in the bag, wounds sealed.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 連續環形撕囊（CCC）
steps.objective: 製作 5–5.5 mm 居中的連續撕囊。
steps.objectiveEn: Create a centred 5–5.5 mm continuous capsulorhexis.
steps.instruction: cystotome 起瓣，撕囊鑷以剪切力沿圓周牽引，重新抓取保持控制；囊膜染色（trypan blue）用於白內障成熟者。
steps.instructionEn: Start a flap with the cystotome, use forceps with shearing force around the circle, regrasp to keep control; trypan blue for mature cataracts.
steps.observation: 撕囊邊緣完整覆蓋光學區。
steps.observationEn: Rhexis edge overlaps the optic 360°.
steps.failure: 撕裂向外延伸（run-out）可致後囊破裂。
steps.failureEn: A radial run-out can extend to the posterior capsule.
steps.check: CCC 完整。
steps.checkEn: Complete CCC.

knowledge.title: 飛秒雷射
knowledge.text: 可產生精確圓形撕囊。
knowledge.textEn: Produces a precise circular capsulotomy.

quiz.question: 「連續環形撕囊（CCC）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Continuous curvilinear capsulorhexis'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
CCC 完整。
切口自閉。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Complete CCC.
Self-sealing incision.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 水分離與水分層
steps.objective: 分離核與囊及皮質。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate the nucleus from capsule and cortex.
steps.instruction: 平針頭於撕囊緣下注入 BSS 見液波通過後方，輕壓核使液體排出；旋轉核確認自由。
steps.instructionEn: BSS under the rhexis edge until a fluid wave passes posteriorly, gently depress the nucleus to vent; rotate to confirm freedom.
steps.observation: 核可自由旋轉。
steps.observationEn: Nucleus rotates freely.
steps.failure: 過度注水使囊袋阻塞而爆裂（capsular block）。
steps.failureEn: Over-injection causes capsular block and rupture.
steps.check: 核已分離。
steps.checkEn: Nucleus freed.

knowledge.title: 後極白內障
knowledge.text: 避免水分離以免後囊破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Avoid hydrodissection to prevent posterior capsule rupture.

quiz.question: 「水分離與水分層」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Hydrodissection and hydrodelineation'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
核已分離。
同意書與查核表完整。
核完全清除。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Nucleus freed.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Nucleus fully removed.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 超音波乳化碎核
steps.objective: 以分而治之或 stop-and-chop 碎核。
steps.objectiveEn: Divide and conquer or stop-and-chop.
steps.instruction: 刻槽至 90% 深度，分裂成四象限，以超音波與真空吸除碎片；保持針尖在瞳孔中央、斜面向上，功率與真空依核硬度調整。
steps.instructionEn: Groove to 90% depth, crack into quadrants, emulsify fragments with ultrasound and vacuum; keep the tip central, bevel up, adjust power and vacuum to nuclear density.
steps.observation: 記錄有效超音波時間。
steps.observationEn: Record effective phaco time.
steps.failure: 後囊破裂的徵象：前房突然加深、瞳孔散大、碎片沉降。
steps.failureEn: Posterior capsule rupture signs: sudden deepening, pupil dilation, fragment descent.
steps.check: 核完全清除。
steps.checkEn: Nucleus fully removed.

knowledge.title: 角膜內皮保護
knowledge.text: 黏彈劑與最小超音波能量。
knowledge.textEn: Viscoelastic and minimal ultrasound energy.

quiz.question: 「超音波乳化碎核」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Phacoemulsification of the nucleus'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
核完全清除。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
切口自閉。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Nucleus fully removed.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Self-sealing incision.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 皮質清除與人工水晶體植入
steps.objective: 清除皮質並植入囊袋內 IOL。
steps.objectiveEn: Remove cortex and implant the IOL in the bag.
steps.instruction: I/A 由囊下抓取皮質向中央拉出；黏彈劑撐開囊袋，摺疊式 IOL 經主切口注入，確認襻在囊袋內，吸除黏彈劑，切口水密。
steps.instructionEn: I/A: engage cortex under the capsule and strip centrally; inflate the bag with viscoelastic, inject the foldable IOL, confirm haptics in the bag, remove viscoelastic, hydrate the wounds.
steps.observation: 確認 IOL 居中與切口密閉。
steps.observationEn: Confirm centration and wound seal.
steps.failure: 殘留黏彈劑造成術後眼壓升高。
steps.failureEn: Retained viscoelastic raises post-operative pressure.
steps.check: IOL 在囊袋內、切口密閉。
steps.checkEn: IOL in the bag, wounds sealed.

knowledge.title: 多焦點與散光 IOL
knowledge.text: 需精確軸位與病人選擇。
knowledge.textEn: Need precise axis alignment and patient selection.

quiz.question: 「皮質清除與人工水晶體植入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Cortex removal and IOL implantation'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
IOL 在囊袋內、切口密閉。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
IOL in the bag, wounds sealed.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: IOL 在囊袋內、切口密閉。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
核完全清除。
optionsEn: IOL in the bag, wounds sealed.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Nucleus fully removed.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
核已分離。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Nucleus freed.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出超音波乳化白內障手術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Phacoemulsification cataract surgery and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與前處理（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與前處理
steps.objective: 說明人工水晶體度數計算的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where IOL power calculation applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：生物測量、Barrett／Kane 公式與散光矯正水晶體。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Biometry, Barrett/Kane formulas and toric IOLs.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 生物測量、Barrett／Kane 公式與散光矯正水晶體。
knowledge.textEn: Biometry, Barrett/Kane formulas and toric IOLs.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與前處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and pre-analytics'?
options: 已正確完成「Barrett／Kane 公式與散光矯正水晶體」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
optionsEn: 'Barrett/Kane formulas and toric IOLs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: 'Biometry' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
'Barrett/Kane formulas and toric IOLs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 人工水晶體度數計算的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of IOL power calculation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：生物測量
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「生物測量」在人工水晶體度數計算中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Biometry' within IOL power calculation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「生物測量」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Biometry': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「生物測量」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Biometry'.
steps.failure: 若「生物測量」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Biometry' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「生物測量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Biometry' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「生物測量」是人工水晶體度數計算的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Biometry' is a core component of IOL power calculation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

已正確完成「生物測量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
'Barrett/Kane formulas and toric IOLs' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Biometry' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.

steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明飛秒雷射輔助白內障的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：雷射撕囊、碎核與切口。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Laser capsulotomy, fragmentation and incisions.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 雷射撕囊、碎核與切口。
knowledge.textEn: Laser capsulotomy, fragmentation and incisions.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 準備清單完成。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 已正確完成「碎核與切口」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
optionsEn: 'fragmentation and incisions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 飛秒雷射輔助白內障的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：雷射撕囊
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「雷射撕囊」在飛秒雷射輔助白內障中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Laser capsulotomy' within Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「雷射撕囊」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Laser capsulotomy': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「雷射撕囊」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Laser capsulotomy'.
steps.failure: 若「雷射撕囊」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Laser capsulotomy' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「雷射撕囊」是飛秒雷射輔助白內障的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Laser capsulotomy' is a core component of Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：雷射撕囊」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Laser capsulotomy'?
options: 已正確完成「碎核與切口」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'fragmentation and incisions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：碎核與切口
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「碎核與切口」在飛秒雷射輔助白內障中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'fragmentation and incisions' within Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「碎核與切口」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'fragmentation and incisions': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「碎核與切口」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'fragmentation and incisions'.
steps.failure: 若「碎核與切口」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'fragmentation and incisions' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「碎核與切口」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'fragmentation and incisions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「碎核與切口」是飛秒雷射輔助白內障的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'fragmentation and incisions' is a core component of Femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：碎核與切口」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: fragmentation and incisions'?
options: 已正確完成「碎核與切口」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'fragmentation and incisions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「碎核與切口」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'fragmentation and incisions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Quality, error and safety review'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
已正確完成「雷射撕囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
'Laser capsulotomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出玻璃體切除術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Pars plana vitrectomy.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：25G 三通道、內限膜剝除、氣體／矽油填充。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: 25-gauge three-port set-up, ILM peeling and gas/silicone oil tamponade.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「內限膜剝除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'ILM peeling' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「25G 三通道」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'25-gauge three-port set-up' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依玻璃體切除術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Pars plana vitrectomy.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 玻璃體切除術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Pars plana vitrectomy.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：25G 三通道
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「25G 三通道」在玻璃體切除術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform '25-gauge three-port set-up' within Pars plana vitrectomy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「25G 三通道」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform '25-gauge three-port set-up': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「25G 三通道」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after '25-gauge three-port set-up'.
steps.failure: 若「25G 三通道」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If '25-gauge three-port set-up' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「25G 三通道」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: '25-gauge three-port set-up' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「25G 三通道」是玻璃體切除術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: '25-gauge three-port set-up' is a core component of Pars plana vitrectomy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「25G 三通道」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'25-gauge three-port set-up' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「氣體／矽油填充」並以文字或數據留下證據。

同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'gas/silicone oil tamponade' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出玻璃體切除術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Pars plana vitrectomy and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出視網膜剝離修復的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Retinal detachment repair.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：鞏膜扣壓、氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Scleral buckle, pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「鞏膜扣壓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Scleral buckle' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「鞏膜扣壓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Scleral buckle' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 已正確完成「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依視網膜剝離修復的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Retinal detachment repair.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「鞏膜扣壓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'Scleral buckle' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 視網膜剝離修復的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Retinal detachment repair.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：鞏膜扣壓
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「鞏膜扣壓」在視網膜剝離修復中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Scleral buckle' within Retinal detachment repair, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「鞏膜扣壓」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Scleral buckle': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「鞏膜扣壓」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Scleral buckle'.
steps.failure: 若「鞏膜扣壓」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Scleral buckle' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「鞏膜扣壓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Scleral buckle' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「鞏膜扣壓」是視網膜剝離修復的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Scleral buckle' is a core component of Retinal detachment repair; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：鞏膜扣壓」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Scleral buckle'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「鞏膜扣壓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'Scleral buckle' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」在視網膜剝離修復中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' within Retinal detachment repair, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy'.
steps.failure: 若「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」是視網膜剝離修復的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' is a core component of Retinal detachment repair; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy'?
options: 已正確完成「氣體視網膜固定與玻璃體切除」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「鞏膜扣壓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: 'pneumatic retinopexy and vitrectomy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Scleral buckle' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
